title: Bosscha Zeiss Dome — Lembang

terrainReference.basis: Native main-building centroid selected before independent field and all floors/main sections/geometry; provider-relative ground, not a surveyed foundation.

mapIdentity.provider: Original OpenStreetMap main named Bosscha Observatory circular building way183137134/Q126583, independently matched to the owner-described Zeiss dome building. Point story refers to institution; this is its complete defining main physical building, not a campus proxy.
mapIdentity.scope: Whole Bosscha Zeiss dome building (Gedung Koepel) associated with The Tea Planter’s Telescope story: full original mapped circular base envelope, cylindrical exterior walls, full14.5m steel rotating dome in a closed static pose, support/rotation band, entrance and windows. Other discrete observatory buildings, telescopes, landscaped campus and interiors are separate structures excluded. Owner instrument record gives14.5m dome diameter and2mm steel construction; native outline supplies full horizontal base. Native outer ring interpreted as base/apron rather than dome diameter. Wall height, vertical profile, ring divisions, shutter seam, door/window census/bearings, base divisions and finishes are bounded estimates. No photographs, drawings or figures used and no photographic fidelity claimed.

note: Original native main-building ring and primary14.5m dome diameter fixed first; independent original terrain acquired before main sections. Floor0 at centroid contact. Estimated outer apron/base,6.8m dome spring level and hemispherical7.25m rise produce14.05m approximate height. Fittings/bearings/finishes estimated, no photographs used.
